units.source_text: 他那惆怅的神情，众侍女都觉得可爱。

en.t: All the ladies in waiting found his melancholy expression charming.

units.source_text: 原来薰君并不像别人那样暴露失恋的苦情，但因人品关系，总会惹人同情。

en.t: Kaoru, unlike others, did not openly show the pain of disappointed love, but because of his character he always stirred sympathy.

units.source_text: 他说：“谈得多了，深恐失言，告辞了。”

en.t: He said, "If I talk too much, I fear I may say something improper, so I shall take my leave."
He rose and was about to go.

units.source_text: 忽闻冷泉院召唤：“到这里来！”

en.t: Suddenly he heard Reizei-in calling, "Come here!"

units.source_text: 薰君虽然心绪不宁，只得向新皇妃那边走去。

en.t: Although Kaoru was unsettled, he had no choice but to walk over toward the new imperial consort.

units.source_text: 冷泉院对他说道：“听夕雾右大臣说：已故的六条院主常在踏歌会的次日举行妇女的音乐演奏会，非常富有趣味。

en.t: Reizei-in said to him, "I heard from Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, that the late lord of Rokujo often held concerts by the women on the day after the Toka festival, and that they were deeply delightful.

units.source_text: 现今世间，无论何事，能承继六条院的人不易多得了。

en.t: In the world today, in any matter at all, there are few people capable of carrying on Rokujo's way.

units.source_text: 当时六条院内，长于音乐的妇女甚多，即使小小的集会，也都非常美妙。”

en.t: At that time there were many women at Rokujo who excelled in music, and even their smallest gatherings were wonderfully beautiful."

units.source_text: 冷泉院缅怀当年，不胜孺慕，便命调整弦乐器，叫新皇妃弹筝，薰君弹琵琶，他自己弹和琴，三人合奏催马乐《此殿》等曲。

en.t: Reizei-in, overcome with longing as he recalled those days, ordered the stringed instruments tuned, had the new imperial consort play the koto, Kaoru play the biwa, and himself played the wagon, the three of them performing saibara pieces such as "This Palace" together.

units.source_text: 薰君听了新皇妃的弹筝，想道：“她本来还有不精到之处，现在被冷泉院教得很好了。

en.t: As Kaoru listened to the new imperial consort play the koto, he thought, "There used to be places where her playing was not quite refined, but now Reizei-in has taught her very well.

units.source_text: 那爪音弹得很入时流，歌和曲都表演得很高明。

en.t: The touch of her nails is very much in the current style, and both the singing and the music are performed with great skill.

units.source_text: 此人事事都无缺陷，件件都不让人，可知容颜一定也很姣美。”

en.t: She lacks nothing in anything and yields to no one in any accomplishment, so her face must surely be very beautiful as well."
He still could not give up his longing for her.

units.source_text: 此种机会既多，自然日渐接近，互相见惯了。

en.t: As such occasions became frequent, they naturally grew closer day by day and became accustomed to seeing one another.

units.source_text: 他虽然没有引人怨恨的越礼行为，但每逢机会，亦常隐约诉说事与愿违之苦。

en.t: Although he did nothing improper enough to earn anyone's resentment, whenever he had the chance he would often hint at the pain of having his wishes thwarted.

units.source_text: 新皇妃对他作何感想，则不得而知了。

en.t: What the new imperial consort thought of him, however, could not be known.
